title: Treasury Analyst
summary: A treasury analyst makes sure a company has the cash it needs each day, forecasts cash flows, and manages bank relationships, forex (foreign currency) risk and the investment of surplus cash. You sit in the corporate finance team under a treasury manager, working closely with accounts and the company's banks.
dailyDuties: Prepare the daily cash position across bank accounts
Update the weekly cash flow forecast and explain variances
Coordinate with banks on accounts, mandates and limits
Track forex exposure and book forward contracts
Place surplus cash in deposits or debt funds
Process letters of credit and bank guarantees
Report liquidity and investments to finance leadership

skills.expectation: Prepare the daily cash position and manage liquidity across bank accounts
Build weekly and monthly cash flow forecasts and explain variances
Handle bank accounts, mandates, limits and day-to-day bank coordination
Track forex exposure and support hedging with forward contracts
Place surplus funds in deposits and debt funds within policy limits
Build cash, investment and exposure reports in Excel
Work with accounts, procurement, sales and banks on fund flows
Process letters of credit and bank guarantees and follow FEMA rules
Use a treasury management system or SAP treasury
Do bank reconciliations and treasury accounting entries
Write clear treasury reports for finance leadership
